rationale: The agent appeared to identify the user and retrieve orders, then proceeded to modify an order address and swap items (watches and an air purifier) and charge the credit card. However, per the policy, the agent must confirm with the user before any order-changing write. There is no evidence of an explicit confirmation step before updating the address, changing the watch variant, or processing the price difference on the credit card. The agent also declared success and a charge had occurred without prior user approval. While actions seem to be on the user’s own orders and authentication was attempted (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details), the lack of pre-change confirmation and unapproved charging violate the policy, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
